resources.name: QUIP (GAP) package
resources.notes: Framework for Gaussian approximation potentials with SOAP descriptors; used for training GAP models and computing forces/energies.

resources.name: LAMMPS
resources.notes: Molecular dynamics simulator; used for melt-quench, MD with GAP potentials, and Green-Kubo heat flux integration.

resources.name: Phonopy
resources.notes: Package for harmonic lattice dynamics; used with DFT to obtain force constants and normal modes for c-Si.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code used as an alternative to VASP; provides PBE-level accuracy for Si.

resources.name: Stillinger-Weber potential parameters for Si
resources.notes: Parameter set for the SW potential; available in LAMMPS distribution. Used to generate the initial amorphous silicon structure via melt-quench MD.

resources.name: Silicon pseudopotential (PBE)
resources.notes: Norm-conserving or PAW pseudopotential for Si in QE; equivalent to the PAW set used in the paper.
